content.text: Creators in restricted markets are not waiting for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-honest-side-side-breakdown-14|Stripe Alternatives]] to expand its coverage map. They are not petitioning PayPal to reconsider their country risk model. They are building on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-automated-ebook-delivery-after-crypto-8|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] that was never subject to those decisions in the first place. A static storefront on Cloudflare Pages loads in under 200 milliseconds anywhere on earth. NOWPayments accepts payment in USDT, Bitcoin, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/solana-payments-digital-products-what-actually-how-works-6|solana]], and 300 plus other coins from any buyer with a wallet — no account creation, no identity verification, no geography check. The webhook fires the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. The download link arrives in the buyer's inbox within 30 seconds. This is what sovereign commerce infrastructure looks like operating at full capacity from Lagos, Accra, Nairobi, Karachi, Dhaka, or Harare.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-step-step-deployment-guide. content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Start building your online store today using blockchain technology and free infrastructure. By utilizing Cloudflare Pages for hosting, you can avoid the barriers of traditional payment processors. With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring you get paid internationally in under 60 seconds with fees below $0.10. Setting up this stack requires no complicated integrations or long wait times—just deploy and start selling.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

To set up a minimum viable stack, deploy Cloudflare Pages combined with NOWPayments. This setup allows you to host your digital products and accept payments instantly. Use Google Sheets or Supabase for order management, ensuring you maintain full ownership of your data. This stack is designed specifically for creators like you, who need agile solutions to sell digital products without relying on limited local payment options.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Cloudflare Pages and GitHub Pages both provide free static site hosting that works identically regardless of where the store operator is located. A store deployed on Cloudflare Pages by a creator in Harare is served from Cloudflare's global edge network — the same infrastructure that serves enterprises in New York. Neither platform imposes geographic restrictions on who can deploy a store or who can access it. Combined with NOWPayments for payment processing and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, this creates a complete commerce infrastructure with zero hosting costs and no geographic restrictions at any layer of the stack.
Launch your digital store today without traditional payment barriers.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To get your first transaction live, ensure your products are uploaded and your payment processor is connected. Promote your digital products through social media or local communities to drive traffic to your store. Test your checkout process by making a small purchase to ensure everything operates smoothly. Once the first transaction is complete, you’ll gain confidence in your setup and can start scaling your efforts.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

The Edge Commerce Stack that COREMERCH deploys most frequently combines Cloudflare Pages for storefront hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend webhook handling and order processing, Supabase for order storage, Resend for transactional email delivery, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. The total monthly cost is zero. The scale ceiling is significantly higher than what most individual creators need — Cloudflare Workers handles 100,000 requests per day on the free tier, Supabase provides 500MB of PostgreSQL storage, and Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month. For a creator in any country on earth, this stack provides the same infrastructure as a well-funded e-commerce operation at no monthly cost.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
Get paid in under 60 seconds using cryptocurrencies.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Global access to digital product revenue is not contingent on where you are located — it is contingent on which infrastructure you build on. The sovereign stack works identically from Lagos, Accra, Nairobi, Karachi, Dhaka, Harare, or Manila. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours under your accounts, tested on mainnet before handoff. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete build for self-deployers. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I accept payments in Kenya without Stripe?

You can accept payments by using NOWPayments, which allows you to process cryptocurrency transactions directly. This solution bypasses traditional banking limitations and enables you to receive payments instantly.
What cryptocurrencies can I use to sell my products?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT on Tron. This wide selection gives your customers flexibility in payment methods.
What are the transaction fees using this method?
The transaction fee with NOWPayments is only 0.5%, ensuring that you retain a larger portion of your sales revenue compared to traditional payment processors that often charge higher fees.
How quickly can I receive payments?
Payments through NOWPayments settle in under 60 seconds, providing you with immediate access to your funds without the delays typical of conventional banking systems.
Can I sell to international customers from Kenya?
Yes, by using a blockchain payment system, you can effectively sell your digital products to international customers without facing restrictions imposed by local payment platforms.
